budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Measured on exact mid-W gate bb557ca99 (read-only TT post-CTS STA, 4c02a5660 + hh0600 re-run): the tile's ONLY failing endpoint is the fault pin-register clone ot_prs_00000_ff at NE (95.9,384.5); its check cone (a0/v0 W y5..33, tkw lane4 S, meta N) sits SW, so sources cross the tile twice: sid_q -48.60, islot_q -46.33, rgx_ctrl -39.24, tkw -11.84 ps; a0 +88, v0 +12. SID alone is not the cause (islot fails equally) -> no SID-specialised masters. Additive grant writer_roots_v6_fsw_1016 moves only the 1-bit sticky fault E384.444 -> W14.844 (existing rgx_addr gap); same RTL/16 roots/cycles; other 5,099 bits unchanged.
